text.body: || aśvatthastotram || śrī nārada uvāca anāyāsena loko'yam sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt | sarvadevātmakaṃ caikaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha || brahmovāca śruṇu deva mune'śvatthaṃ śuddhaṃ sarvātmakaṃ tarum | yatpradakṣiṇato lokaḥ sarvān kāmān samaśnute || aśvatthāddakṣiṇe rudraḥ paścime viṣṇurāsthitaḥ | brahmā cottaradeśasthaḥ pūrvetvindrādidevatāḥ || skandhopaskandhapatreṣu govipramunayastathā | mūlaṃ vedāḥ payo yajñāḥ saṃsthitā munipuṅgava || pūrvādidikṣu saṃyātā nadīnadasaro'bdhayaḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena hyaśvatthaṃ saṃśrayedbudhaḥ || tvaṃ kṣīryaphalakaścaiva śītalasya vanaspate | tvāmārādhya naro vindyādaihikāmuṣmikaṃ phalam || caladdalāya vṛkṣāya sarvadāśritaviṣṇave | bodhisatvāya devāya hyaśvatthāya namo namaḥ || aśvattha yasmāt tvayi vṛkṣarāja nārāyaṇastiṣṭhati sarvakāle | athaḥ śrutastvaṃ satataṃ tarūṇāṃ dhanyo'si cāriṣṭavināśako'si || kṣīradastvaṃ ca yeneha yena śrīstvāṃ niṣevate | satyena tena vṛkṣendra māmapi śrīrniṣevatām || ekādaśātmarudro'si vasunāthaśiromaṇiḥ | nārāyaṇo'si devānāṃ vṛkṣarājo'si pippala || agnigarbhaḥ śamīgarbho devagarbhaḥ prajāpatiḥ | hiraṇyagarbho bhūgarbho yajñagarbho namo'stu te || āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūni ca | brahma prajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvaṃ no dehi vanaspate || satataṃ varuṇo rakṣet tvāmārāddṛṣṭirāśrayet | paritastvāṃ niṣevantāṃ tṛṇāni sukhamastu te || akṣispandaṃ bhujaspandaṃ duḥsvapnaṃ durvicintanam | śatrūṇāṃ ca samutthānaṃ hyaśvattha śamaya prabho || aśvatthāya vareṇyāya sarvaiśvarya pradāyine | namo duḥsvapnanāśāya susvapnaphaladāyine || mūlato brahmarūpāya madhyato viṣṇu rūpiṇe | agrataḥ śivarūpāya vṛkṣarājāya te namaḥ || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate rogaiḥ spṛṣṭvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate | yadāśrayāccirañjīvī tamaśvatthaṃ namāmyaham || aśvattha sumahābhāga subhaga priyadarśana | iṣṭakāmāṃśca me dehi śatrubhyastu parābhavam || āyuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ sarvasampadam | dehi deva mahāvṛkṣa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || ṛgyajuḥsāmamantrātmā sarvarūpī parātparaḥ | aśvattho vedamūlo'sāvṛṣibhiḥ procyate sadā || brahmahā guruhā caiva daridro vyādhipīḍitaḥ | āvṛtya lakṣasaṃkhyaṃ tat stotrametat sukhī bhavet || brahmacārī haviṣyāśī tvadaḥśāyī jitendriyaḥ | papopahatacitto'pi vratametat samācaret || ekāhastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā kuryādgomayalepanam | arcet puruṣasūktena praṇavena viśeṣataḥ || maunī pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt prāguktaphalabhāgbhavet | viṣṇornāmasahasreṇa hyacyutasyāpi kīrtanāt || pade padāntaraṃ gatvā karaceṣṭāvivarjitaḥ | vācā stotraṃ mano dhyāne caturaṅgaṃ pradakṣiṇam || aśvatthaḥ sthāpito yena tatkulaṃ sthāpitaṃ tataḥ | dhanāyuṣāṃ samṛddhistu narakāt tārayet pitṛn || aśvatthamūlamāśritya śākānnodakadānataḥ | ekasmin bhojite vipre koṭibrāhmaṇabhojanam || aśvatthamūlamāśritya japahomasurārcanāt | akṣayaṃ phalamāpnoti brahmaṇo vacanaṃ yathā || evamāśvāsito'śvatthaḥ sadāśvāsāya kalpate | yajñārthaṃ chedite'śvatthe hyakṣayaṃ svargamāpnuyāt || chinno yena vṛthā'śvatthaścheditā pitṛdevatāḥ | aśvatthaḥ pūjito yatra pūjitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ || || iti aśvattha stotraṃ sampūrṇam ||
